rivers.name: Ganga (Ganges)
rivers.description: The Ganga is the most sacred river in Hinduism and the longest river in India. It originates from the Gangotri Glacier and flows into the Bay of Bengal.
facts: Declared National River of India in 2008

rivers.name: Yamuna
rivers.description: The Yamuna is the second-largest tributary of the Ganga. It flows through Delhi and Agra, where the Taj Mahal stands on its banks.
facts: Taj Mahal stands on its banks

rivers.name: Brahmaputra
rivers.description: The Brahmaputra is one of the major rivers of Asia. It originates in Tibet and flows through Arunachal Pradesh and Assam before entering Bangladesh.
facts: One of the largest rivers by discharge
Majuli island formed in its waters

rivers.name: Godavari
rivers.description: The Godavari is the second-longest river in India and the longest peninsular river. It is known as the 'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganges of the South).
facts: Dakshin Ganga — Ganges of the South

rivers.name: Krishna
rivers.description: The Krishna is one of the longest rivers in India. It flows through the Deccan Plateau and empties into the Bay of Bengal.

rivers.name: Narmada
rivers.description: The Narmada is the longest west-flowing river in India. It flows through the Narmada Valley and empties into the Arabian Sea.

rivers.name: Cauvery (Kaveri)
rivers.description: The Cauvery is a sacred river in South India. It is the source of water for major cities like Bengaluru and Chennai.
facts: Cauvery water dispute between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu

rivers.name: Mahanadi
rivers.description: The Mahanadi is the major river of Odisha. The Hirakud Dam on the Mahanadi is one of the longest earthen dams in the world.

rivers.name: Indus
rivers.description: The Indus is one of the longest rivers in Asia. The Indus Valley Civilization, one of the world's earliest, flourished on its banks.

rivers.name: Tapti (Tapi)
rivers.description: The Tapti is one of the major west-flowing rivers of India. It flows parallel to the Narmada and empties into the Arabian Sea.
